items.source: Sina Fashion (新浪时尚热点小时报)
items.title: 古驰二手保值率分析：酒神包等经典款跌破五折
items.summary: Chinese fashion-hour digest reports Gucci bags retain poor resale value, with secondhand prices commonly dropping to 40-60% of original; a Dionysus bag originally over RMB 20,000 often resells near RMB 10,000, some units under RMB 3,000. Article concludes Gucci is fine for personal use but a poor investment versus Hermes/Chanel.

items.title: 古驰2026转型：降价30%、换帅Demna、关店自救
items.summary: Weibo explainer post details Gucci's restructuring: roughly 30% price cuts anchoring core styles like the Jackie 1961 at EUR 2,000-3,000, planned store count reduction from ~600 to ~420 by 2030 (about 130 net closures in China), Demna as creative director since Feb 2026, Francesca Bellettini as incoming CEO, and eleven consecutive quarters of declining sales. Frames the moves as a make-or-break turnaround bet.

items.title: 古驰降价与"秒没"代购话术并存，消费者如何辨别真假稀缺
items.summary: Consumer-forum post warns shoppers that Gucci's genuine ~20% price cuts on older SKUs/entry canvas bags coexist with manufactured scarcity marketing around hot items like the Paparazzo bag; posts claiming "only dozens left" often come from resellers, not real shortages. Advises verifying official pricing and comparing tax-free prices (Tokyo, Barcelona) before Double 11.

items.title: Gucci, Prada close more China outlets as consumers cut luxury spending
items.summary: Kering closed two Gucci stores in Shanghai (Reel Department Store near Jing'an Temple and New World Daimaru on Nanjing Road) after over a decade at those sites; Prada exited its Hongqiao airport store. Report frames this as part of an accelerating luxury retreat from China amid weak consumer sentiment and more Chinese shopping abroad.

items.title: 구찌 모기업, 매장 1700여개 중 250개로 감축 목표..."할머니 집 같다" 소비자 혹평
items.summary: Report on Kering's plan to cut Gucci's global store count from over 1,700 toward a minimum of 250 by 2030, about a 40% reduction, as part of a profitability-focused restructuring targeting Gen Z. Consumer quote cited describes a Gucci store as feeling outdated ("grandma's house"). Included despite age because it is the clearest sourcing of the Korea store-count figures still being cited in this week's Korean coverage; flagged as background context, not fresh news.

items.title: 구찌, 2026 가을·겨울 아이웨어 새 시선
items.summary: Brand-owned activation coverage of Gucci's FW26 eyewear campaign, built around portraits of people in reflective moments. Features black acetate Double-G frames and horsebit-detailed round sunglasses; descriptive, no independent evaluative verdict.

items.title: 田曦薇升格Gucci品牌大使，身份对影视资源有何帮助
items.summary: Chinese entertainment outlet covers actress Tian Xiwei's promotion from "brand friend" to full Gucci brand ambassador (effective Sept 21, 2026), discussing how the ambassador title may affect her career/film opportunities. Largely descriptive celebrity-marketing coverage, no independent brand verdict.

items.title: 田曦薇升格Gucci品牌大使冷酷美照公開
items.summary: Taiwanese entertainment-fashion outlet publishes photos marking Tian Xiwei's ambassador promotion, paired with actor PP Krit in all-black styling. Purely descriptive activation write-up.

items.title: 구찌지갑 짭인지 분간좀.. (Gucci wallet authenticity check thread)
items.summary: Korean luxury-forum thread where a user asks the community to help verify whether a purchased Gucci wallet is authentic or counterfeit; replies discuss stitching, hardware, and dust-bag tells. Reflects ongoing counterfeit-anxiety chatter around the brand rather than brand-driven content.

items.title: 古驰目标客群是谁？降价40%背后，品牌定位正在换血
items.summary: Weibo post argues Gucci's up-to-40% bag price cuts in China signal a repositioning away from "cold luxury" toward accessible/light-luxury lifestyle branding, aimed at recovering a broader middle-market customer base it had priced out. Treats the repricing as a symptom of eroded brand pricing power.

items.title: グッチが18％の減収…アジアでの売上不振が影響
items.summary: Japanese business outlet reports Gucci quarterly revenue fell 18%, attributing the decline largely to weak Asia sales, continuing a multi-quarter downturn narrative for the brand within Kering's results.

items.title: 샤넬·구찌도 국내서 꺾였다…심상찮은 명품 약세
items.summary: Korean business daily reports Chanel and Gucci both show softening domestic sales as the broader Korean luxury market cools; links the slowdown to consumers shifting spend toward overseas travel and away from logo-heavy luxury goods post-pandemic.
